verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a scraping service, so the axis applies. Every documented capability, however, is a hosted API that needs a ScrapingBee API key. The GitHub-hosted CLI is a client to that service, not a self-hostable scraper. Community comments suggest running local alternatives instead of ScrapingBee, which implies no open-source self-host option exists.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service
